title.en: [[monitor]] !{{has not been active for at least|has been active within the last}} [[hours]] hours

titleFormatted.en: [[monitor]] !{{has not been active for at least|has been active within the last}} [[hours]] hours

hint.en: True when the monitor is idle and its last cycle ended at least this long ago (for a monitor that has not finished a cycle yet, since it was first seen). False while it is running, or before it has recorded anything. For a freezer, a pump or a door that should have cycled by now. Works with Activity and State monitors.
